_comment: Which checkpoint this service serves. Here rather than in server.mjs because changing
the model used to mean editing a constant, a directory name, a mount path, a page and a
README -- five places that have to agree, and nothing to notice when they stop.
repoPath   where the checkpoint sits INSIDE that repository, "" when it is at the root
directory  the local directory under models/, and the path it is served at
files      what to fetch, relative to repoPath; the first one is also the completeness marker
